Over F̄_5 on y² = x⁵ − x one has y² = b² + t⁵ − t with t = x − a and b² = a⁵ − a, and expanding √(1+s) in characteristic 5 gives b⁵y ≡ b⁶ − 3b⁴t + 3b²t² − t³ = H(t) modulo t⁵, so G = b⁵y − H vanishes to order at least 5 at P.
